components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:0.65rem;min-height:3.25rem;padding:0.5rem 1.5rem;border-radius:999px;font-family:Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:600;font-size:1rem;border:0;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 240ms ease,color 240ms ease,box-shadow 240ms ease,transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);text-decoration:none;position:relative;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}.ds-btn-champagne{background:var(--color-champagne,#cdae7a);color:var(--color-fondente,#170e0a)}.ds-btn-champagne::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:linear-gradient(105deg,transparent 35%,rgb(255 248 228/0.6) 50%,transparent 65%);transform:translateX(-110%);transition:transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)}.ds-btn-champagne:hover{background:#dbbe8c;transform:translateY(-2px)}.ds-btn-champagne:hover::after{transform:translateX(110%)}.ds-btn:active{transform:scale(0.97)}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #cdae7a;outline-offset:3px}.ds-btn svg{transition:transform 300ms}.ds-btn:hover svg{transform:translateX(4px)}

narrative.overview:
The page is a pastry tray: deep cream paper, champagne-gold cake boards and ribbon, dark chocolate glaze. Light grounds (avorio, crema, sabbia) alternate with chocolate panels, and every surface after the entrance slides up over the previous one as a rounded sheet, like a new tray set on the counter. The shop's own sign lettering, vectorised from the 1979 facade, is the signature: it appears in champagne foil in the glass header and full width in the footer, and in champagne-scuro on the order ticket.

Type is a two-voice pairing: Cormorant Garamond speaks (section titles, the shop name, quotes, numerals), Manrope reads (body, labels, controls). Motion is generous but physical: text rises line by line out of a mask, photos parallax inside their frames, cards tilt toward the mouse, a sliding pill marks the active choice. Everything collapses to still states under reduced motion.

Density is relaxed: large serif titles, short measured paragraphs (44 to 54ch), photos always inside an ivory passe-partout. Real material only: the shop's photos, the real hours, real Google reviews quoted verbatim.
keyCharacteristics: Cream grounds, champagne accent, chocolate for text, panels, and the night ground.
Sections overlap as rounded sheets (2.5rem, 3.5rem from md) pulled up 40px / 56px.
The 1979 sign lettering in champagne foil is the only logo.
Photos sit in an ivory passe-partout with a long, low chocolate shadow.
Pills for every action; one fill per button.

rules.name: The One Metal Rule
rules.body: Champagne is the only accent. On light grounds it appears as champagne-scuro text or as a fill under fondente text, never as champagne text on cream.

rules.name: The Foil Rule
rules.body: The vertical champagne foil gradient (`.foil`, `.insegna-foil`) is reserved for the shop's name, the sign lettering, and the big numerals (numbers band, rating). Never on body copy or buttons.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif for what the shop says, sans for what the visitor reads or operates. Controls, legends, and data are never serif, except the stepper value and numerals.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: No uppercase, no tracked-out labels, no kickers above titles. Hierarchy comes from the serif size step and color.

rules.name: The Glass Floats Rule
rules.body: Glass only on what floats above content: the header, the menu's shortcut tray, the photo viewer controls. Never on an in-flow card.

dos: Do frame every product photo in the avorio passe-partout with the passe-partout shadow.
Do keep each section a rounded sheet overlapping the previous one, alternating light and chocolate grounds.
Do put champagne fills under fondente text and use champagne-scuro for accent text on light grounds.
Do use the sign lettering (insegna mask) as the only wordmark.
Do reveal headlines with the masked stagger and ease every transition on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).
Do give every motion a still state under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't use foil on anything other than the name, the sign, and the big numerals.
Don't add uppercase tracked labels or eyebrow kickers above section titles.
Don't draw borders; use inset hairlines and tonal layers.
Don't use glass on in-flow content.
Don't set controls or body copy in the serif.
Don't break the vetrina grid's symmetry (2 or 4 equal columns).
